amendment_scope: Pre-outcome identity/timing and confirmation-capacity repair: all five scored mechanisms use statistics-DBN date-bounded symbology before target-definition filtering, the configured 23:59 UTC conservative market cutoff, future-only settlement targets, label-availability-aware walk-forward fitting, and a chronologically latest reserved-confirmation block. One hundred percent of each admissible prepared panel, including reserved rows, must pass deterministic preparation/usability assurance before scoring; reserved outcomes are then excluded from all Phase-1 fitting, scoring, descriptive outcome analysis, tuning, disposition and human inspection until separately authorized confirmation. No Phase-1 forecast disposition was accepted before these repairs.

source_policy.market_identity: exact acquired Databento GLBX.MDP3 archive with statistics-metadata [start_date,end_date) symbology resolved before NG outright definition filtering

reserved_confirmation.permitted_pre_freeze_operations: deterministic acquisition/reconstruction/normalization/PIT/identity/coverage/missingness/feature-target/usability validation plus opaque content hashing and sealed-window registration
reserved_confirmation.prohibited_pre_freeze_operations: model fitting, prediction scoring, benchmark comparison, effect estimation, tuning, disposition, visualization, empirical summary or human inspection of reserved outcomes
reserved_confirmation.boundary_control: purge research rows whose target availability reaches or crosses the first reserved prediction timestamp
reserved_confirmation.failure_rule: repair data or redesign before development scoring if reserved rows do not pass the same preparation/usability contract

chronology.label_availability_rule: At each prediction cutoff, model fitting may use only prior rows whose target-end settlement is already available under the same 23:59 UTC conservative market availability bound.

rep-004-rep-005.reason: PIT WNGSR release-state reconstruction begins in 2024; the long EIA bulk history is current revised truth and is prohibited from predictive feature use
rep-004-rep-005.research_oos: all subsequent valid PIT release rows before the reserved-confirmation block
rep-004-rep-005.state_fit: first 52 valid PIT storage releases only; no market outcomes used to set storage scaling or threshold

rep-009.reason: verified release-calendar identity covers the reconstructed WNGSR event window
rep-009.research_oos: all subsequent same-contract daily targets inside verified release-calendar coverage before the reserved-confirmation block

disposition.kill: relative RMSE improvement <= 0 with bootstrap upper CI <= 0, or negative RMSE improvement in at least two chronological thirds
disposition.economic_plausibility: improvement must arise from information available at prediction time and not depend on roll contamination or a single chronological third

rep_001.reproduction: same-contract absolute log returns by fixed DTE bucket with winter/non-winter reporting
rep_001.prediction_time: trade_date 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff
rep_001.target: absolute same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time

rep_002.reproduction: M1-M6 log-price slope and winter/injection seasonal contrast
rep_002.prediction_time: trade_date 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff
rep_002.target: same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time

rep_004.stage_a_reproduction: current revised EIA historical storage truth may be used only for descriptive mechanism reproduction and may not enter predictive features
rep_004.prediction_time: release-day 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff, after the PIT WNGSR state is public
rep_004.target: same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time
rep_004.storage_state: level/change standardized on first 52 valid PIT release rows; low_inventory is fixed first-52 25th percentile; no OOS refit

rep_005.stage_a_reproduction: 844-week current revised historical-truth overlap is descriptive only; PIT extension is scored separately
rep_005.prediction_time: release-day 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff, after the PIT WNGSR state is public
rep_005.target: absolute same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time
rep_005.storage_state: same frozen first-52 PIT transform as rep-004

rep_009.stage_a_reproduction: verified release/control-day volatility contrast inside the reconstructed WNGSR calendar window
rep_009.prediction_time: trade_date 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff; target-end release identity is advance-known calendar information
rep_009.target: absolute same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time; the release flag applies to the target-end trade date
rep_009.calendar_rule: holiday-shifted releases are classified by actual verified release date; dates outside verified calendar coverage are excluded

rep_018.stage_a_reproduction: 2003-2018 public source-era near reproduction of the negative announcement premium, with exact-contract 2010-2018 overlap reported separately and Bloomberg surprise controls fidelity-bounded
rep_018.prediction_time: trade_date 23:59 UTC conservative market availability cutoff; the target-end standard release identity is known from the calendar before prediction time
rep_018.target: signed same-contract log return from the next trade-date settlement after prediction cutoff to the following trade-date settlement, using expiration-ranked M1 selected at prediction time; release identity applies to the target-end trade date
rep_018.benchmark: fixed RidgeReturnModel(alpha=10) using target-end weekday and winter calendar controls but excluding the release-day flag
rep_018.challenger_model: fixed RidgeReturnModel(alpha=10) using the same calendar controls plus target_end_release
rep_018.calendar_rule: standard Thursdays reconstructed from WNGSR Friday week-ending identities; any unresolved federal-holiday week is excluded rather than guessed
rep_018.translation_rule: the release-day feature must improve the fixed weekday/winter calendar benchmark under the common RMSE/bootstrap/chronological-thirds survival gate; post-2018 literature evidence cannot alter features or thresholds
